verdict.rationale: Kick documents its own first-party CLI with a quickstart covering authentication, workspace selection, and pulling transactions or financial statements from the terminal. The AI docs and pricing page also position the CLI alongside MCP for automating workflows. missing for 10: full command reference documentation, evidence of write/update operations via CLI (docs describe lookups and reports), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Run accounting lookups and reports from your terminal. Authenticate, pick a workspace, and pull transactions or financial statements with the Kick CLI.
Connect MCP or CLI to take it further: query your client data in plain language, automate month-end checks, and build workflows that run across every workspace.
